title: CONTEXT.yaml
description: A bounded context's glossary. Terms only — no implementation details.

name.description: The context name. Must match the name used for this context in CONTEXT-MAP.yaml.

description.description: One or two sentences on what this context is responsible for.

language.description: The ubiquitous language for this context. Only terms unique to this context.

definition.description: What the term IS, not what it does. One or two sentences.

group.description: Optional cluster label when natural groups of terms emerge.
